title: MS-Net: a novel lightweight and precise model for plant disease identification
summary: MS-Net is evaluated on apple-leaf images including outdoor field-condition images and reports disease-identification performance beyond PlantVillage; the result is a specific plant-disease recognition application, with dataset and deployment limits.
